name: First to Strike, First to Fall
text: Whenever you successfully Strike a creature that has not acted in the first round of combat, that creature is Off-Guard until the end of your next turn. If that creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points before the end of your next turn, you and all allies within 30 feet of the creature become Quickened until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Step, Stride, or Strike.
